title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 13 AUGUST 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 13 August 2026. Several spells of showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya, Galle and Matara districts. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva and Eastern province and in Mullaitivu district after 2.00 p.m. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
